block_b_transfer_rule.e4_requirement: At least one realization must be genuinely held out from bridge identification; no core edit, bridge semantic redesign, or per-realization B3 refit.

requirements: strictly greater E4 pressure coverage or E5 cross-pressure coverage

evidence_rules.E1_QUALITATIVE_MECHANISM: Only mechanism/shape analogy; never engineering validation.
evidence_rules.E2_EXACT_STRUCTURAL_CONSTRAINT: Exact finite candidate theorem/readout implies the frozen definition-stripped structural target statement, but no engineering-unit quantitative residual is testable.
evidence_rules.E3_QUANTITATIVE_CONSTRUCTION: Requires numerical measured values and a declared construction subset sufficient to compute a residual under the source envelope. Not available in the frozen R049 artifacts for any row.
evidence_rules.E4_QUANTITATIVE_OUT_OF_SAMPLE: Requires parameters/bridge frozen on construction data then numerical evaluation on independent holdout conditions/realization against source-stated envelope. Not available in the frozen R049 artifacts for any row.
evidence_rules.E5_CROSS_PRESSURE_SHARED_EXPLANATION: Requires E4 on at least two independent pressure families under one target-independent bridge schema/shared native state and no per-pressure B3. Therefore ineligible in this R050 run because no row is E4-eligible.

fitted_parameter_policy.B2_allowed_parameter_condition: Finite, explicitly named, bridge-only parameters estimated solely from a predeclared construction subset with a predeclared estimation rule.
fitted_parameter_policy.candidate_core_parameters: FROZEN_R048_ONLY; no estimation or retuning in R050
fitted_parameter_policy.parameter_explosion_rule: Every fitted/calibration parameter and every distinct bridge schema is counted; unbounded or row-codebook parameterization is B3.
fitted_parameter_policy.realization_specific_metrology_constants: Allowed downstream only when source-required; count individually as calibration debt and do not become native premises.

generation_inference_boundary: R050 scores only R048 G2 against R049. No claim that G2 outperforms G1 is permitted.

native_to_measured_output_readout_rules.B0_NATIVE_DIRECT: Target-relevant relation follows from frozen N0/N0-definable candidate structure; representation-only relabeling allowed; no fitted metrology parameter.
native_to_measured_output_readout_rules.B1_UNIFORM_READOUT: One target-independent N2 quotient/readout schema applies without fitted target-specific parameters.
native_to_measured_output_readout_rules.B2_CALIBRATED_METROLOGY_BRIDGE: Bridge form is fixed before holdout evaluation; only finite explicitly named calibration parameters may be estimated on a declared construction subset; all such parameters and source metrology constants count as debt.
native_to_measured_output_readout_rules.B3_TARGET_SPECIFIC_ADAPTER: Protocol-specific adapter/codebook or semantic redesign chosen after target access. May support at most E3 in principle and never E4/E5.
native_to_measured_output_readout_rules.B4_ILLEGAL_LEAKAGE: Effective target definition/output-equivalent structure is imported into native premises. Mapping rejected.

illegal: center, distance/equidistance, radius/circle/sphere, or Euclidean geometry/measure inserted as native structure
angle/radian/degree, cycle origin, 2pi-per-cycle, or classical pi numerical selection inserted as native structure
continuum PDE, heat kernel, Gaussian normalization, Fourier normalization, or classical wave/eigenmode formula inserted before native readout
classical control-volume/inventory balance inserted as a native conservation axiom
acoustic/electromagnetic reciprocity theorem inserted as a native axiom
any target-output value or output-equivalent codebook used to choose or repair a candidate mapping
legal: Map only controlled physical interventions, ordering/role labels, and raw measured-carrier distinctions to structures already supplied by the frozen candidate.
Use implementation labels only as I0 carriers; labels, coordinates, units, device geometry, and classical models do not become N0 by encoding.
A row-independent encoding schema may specialize ordinary carrier labels to a protocol without selecting a mapping by observed target values.
Candidate-declared N1 operations may be invoked exactly as frozen; no new propagation, metric, conservation, reciprocity, spectral, or continuum law may be inserted.

pressure_aggregation.E5: Computed only after pressure-level E4 results exist; at least two independent pressures must share a target-independent bridge schema/shared native state.
pressure_aggregation.block_a: Pressure evidence equals its sole row evidence, subject to the row quantitative-evidence cap.
pressure_aggregation.block_b: Pressure evidence is the highest level supported by every constituent row under one common legal bridge schema; a failed/unmapped row is never averaged away. E4 additionally requires genuine cross-realization holdout transfer.

quantitative_error_policy.allowed_metric: Use only a residual defined between a candidate-predicted measured quantity and the frozen measured-output carrier, normalized/compared solely by the row's source-stated uncertainty/tolerance form.
